speaker: Doctor
text: I need to ask you a few questions to understand what's causing your fatigue and leg pain. Have you noticed any bone pain, especially in your legs, or any small red spots (petechiae) on your skin? When did these symptoms first start, and have you had any recent infections?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history; the onset of fever and severe nocturnal leg pain is very concerning. Have you noticed any swelling in your joints, or do the bruises appear specifically as pinpoint red dots rather than larger patches? Also, has she been drinking and urinating normally despite the fatigue?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely ALL). REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count with Differential, Peripheral Blood Smear, and Urinalysis.
